indexing_checkpoint.note: Across this operation, 58 new documents were added and nine existing documents were text-updated after indexing to correct source caveats or remove negative-evidence wording. Three obsolete chunks were removed only as stale versions of seven earlier modified documents. Group 10 dry runs matched: three new documents/six chunks; its later wording refinement matched at one document/two chunks updated, with no deletions. Group 12 added two documents/four chunks; Group 13 added six documents/12 chunks; Group 14 added one document/two chunks; Group 15 added four documents/17 chunks. A previously mislabelled title and publisher for one Belavadi source record were corrected as metadata-only updates across four chunks; subsequent caveat refinements in the same new document updated at most two chunks and three metadata records without changing total count. The collection is now 516 chunks; all new documents remain pending human review.
